chunks: "Recitation was only appointed in the first two rak'ahs, and tasbih in the last two, in order to distinguish between what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, ordained from Himself and what Allah, Exalted is He, ordained from the direction of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله."

key_terms.رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.ٱلتَّسْبِيحُ: glorification of Allah in the prayer

ai.seo_question: Why is recitation done in the first two rak'ahs and tasbih in the last two of salat?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام explains the wisdom behind recitation in the first two rak'ahs and tasbih in the final two rak'ahs of salat. The distinction reflects the difference between what Allah directly ordained and what He legislated through His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله.
